VALORANT Esports | Champions Shanghai Opening Day

OPENING DAY // CHAMPIONS SHANGHAI

Champions Shanghai starts way before the first bullet is fired.

Forget what you know about Opening Day. This year we’re taking our city-wide collision of culture, community, and competition in China directly to your screen, no matter where you are in the world.

If you aren’t dialed in from the very first minute on September 24 at 1:00am PDT (4:00pm CST), you’re missing out on the most ambitious, chaotic, and beautiful Champions opening we’ve ever built. 

WHAT TO EXPECT

This year’s opening day is bigger than any single stage, so we’re taking you beyond the arena.

  • Opening Day Segments: Segments all across a city that lives and breathes VALORANT Champions. Join us at Pop Mart, Hai Di Lao, DOE, Artist Alley, the VALORANT Concept PC Bang, and on the streets of Shanghai.

MEET THE TALENT

  • Hosts & Creators: 
    • TenZ
    • Sacy
    • TcK
    • MeL
    • Loupiote
    • Spicyuuu
    • SiuFatBB

HOW TO WATCH

Mark your calendars and be there before the starting bell. trust.

  • Date: September 24
  • Start Time: 1:00am PDT, 4:00pm CST
  • Where to Watch: Tune in via the official VALORANT channels.

It’s the biggest stage. The biggest event. The biggest VALORANT Champions celebration in history. We’ll see you in Shanghai.
